name: Seer Graytongue
summary: On Red Cloud Mesa, Seer Graytongue guides young tauren through their first tribal trials. Near Camp Narache in Mulgore, he teaches them to honor the Earthmother before they enter the wider world.

sections.title: A Guide on the Mesa
sections.body: Young tauren braves and spellweavers find Seer Graytongue atop Red Cloud Mesa. From there, he guides those setting out from Camp Narache through sacred steps, including the Rites of the Earthmother. Their trials test resolve against Mulgore’s harsh plains and dangerous beasts. Through them, Graytongue teaches honor, patience, and reverence, virtues every tauren carries into adulthood.

aliases: who is the seer on red cloud mesa
faq.answer: Seer Graytongue is an elder tauren seer who lives in a lodge atop Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. He guides young heroes through traditional ceremonies that prove their worth to the tribe.

faq.q: What trials does Seer Graytongue oversee?
faq.answer: Seer Graytongue guides young tauren through parts of the Rites of the Earthmother, including the Rite of Strength. These rituals test a brave’s fortitude and respect for the plains’ natural balance.

faq.q: Where can I find Seer Graytongue?
faq.answer: Seer Graytongue lives in a leather lodge along the edge of Red Cloud Mesa, just outside Camp Narache in Mulgore.

angles.text: As a young tauren, visiting Seer Graytongue marks a sacred rite of passage, joining personal strength with the Earthmother’s eternal blessings.
As a shaman, you can look to elders like Graytongue to learn how sacred rituals and trials bind a warrior’s physical might to ancestral guidance.
